findings.description: A4 (highest-value advisory): Exec Summary names caffeine/melatonin as Rung-1 anchors with no backing finding — add a supporting clause or soften the anchor list. Inline WebSearch during critique confirmed F6/R6 EFSA-2023 B6 UL=12 mg/day (PMC10189633); IOM-100-vs-EFSA-12 framing correct.
A1: life-stage UL conditionality (pregnancy/age) under-noted in F6 toxicity-ceilings finding.
A2: iron — distinguish acute pediatric-overdose from chronic UL in F6.
A3: add heavy-metal contamination as a third contamination mode alongside drug-spiking and species-mislabeling in F9.
